requirements.statement: The facility shall report annual Power Usage Effectiveness, measured at the utility meter, and keep it at or below 1.40 from the second operating year.
requirements.acceptance: Given 12 months of metered data, when the annual report runs, then PUE is computed per EU Delegated Regulation 2024/1364 Annex I and is 1.40 or lower.
requirements.justification: Efficiency reporting is required for large data centres and drives cooling design.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute Scope 2 emissions with both the location-based and market-based methods and store each monthly result with its emission factor source.
requirements.acceptance: Given a month of meter data and a PPA certificate, when the report runs, then two Scope 2 totals in tCO2e appear with their factor sources.
requirements.user_story: As a sustainability lead, I want both Scope 2 methods so that the BRSR Core filing matches GHG Protocol guidance.
requirements.source_quote: We must file BRSR Core and buy renewable power.
requirements.justification: Dual reporting is needed once renewable contracts are used.

requirements.statement: The tenant portal shall mask personal data before any prompt is sent to a third-party language model, fast enough.
requirements.acceptance: Given a prompt with an email and a phone number, when it is sent, then both are replaced by tags.
requirements.justification: Tenant prompts may hold personal data of Indian residents.

requirements.statement: The campus shall ride through grid frequency events within the limits of the Indian Electricity Grid Code without dropping GPU workloads.
requirements.acceptance: Given a frequency excursion inside IEGC limits, when it lasts 10 s, then no workload restarts are logged.
requirements.justification: Large loads connected to the grid must stay within the grid code band.

requirements.statement: The platform shall report cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing them and keep logs for 180 days inside India.
requirements.acceptance: Given a simulated incident at 09:00, when the runbook runs, then a CERT-In report is filed before 15:00 and logs older than 179 days remain queryable.
requirements.user_story: As a security lead, I want a 6-hour incident clock so that we meet the CERT-In direction.
requirements.justification: CERT-In directions apply to data centres and cloud providers in India.

requirements.statement: The operator shall keep a risk register for each AI model it runs on operations data, reviewed before deployment and every 6 months.
requirements.acceptance: Given a new cooling-control model, when it is proposed for deployment, then a risk register entry with owner and review date exists and is at most 6 months old.
requirements.user_story: As a compliance officer, I want a risk register per model so that AI use follows the NIST AI RMF.
requirements.justification: Operator AI models affect physical plant behaviour.

requirements.statement: The facility shall meter water use per GPU hall and report annual Water Usage Effectiveness in litres per kWh of IT energy.
requirements.acceptance: Given 12 months of water and IT energy data, when the annual report runs, then WUE per hall is reported to 2 decimal places.
requirements.justification: Liquid cooling changes water use, which EU reporting rules ask for.

requirements.statement: The scheduler shall defer batch training jobs when the grid operator sends a demand-response signal, shedding at least 10% of GPU load within 15 minutes.
requirements.acceptance: Given a demand-response signal at 18:00, when the scheduler reacts, then metered GPU load falls by 10% or more within 15 minutes.
requirements.user_story: As an operations manager, I want batch jobs to pause on grid signals so that we earn demand-response credits.
requirements.justification: Flexible AI load helps the grid and lowers cost.

risks.text: Grid ride-through needs spare UPS and cooling capacity that raises PUE.
Tenant prompts could reach third-party models with unmasked personal data.
Market-based Scope 2 depends on PPA certificates arriving on time.

assumptions: The DISCOM provides interval meter data at 15-minute resolution.
Tenants accept a shared CERT-In incident runbook.
open_issues: Water source and discharge permits are not yet known.
